review_scope.stage: proposed task graph closure, before machine DAG compilation
review_scope.catalog_entry_count_basis: Ten work-unit rows T9-T18; the catalog additionally contains three owning module rows.
review_scope.directory_count_basis: Unique immediate parent directories of allowed touched files; each scenario/** root counts as one owned directory.
review_scope.excluded_material: No other critic report or executor narrative was read.
review_scope.runtime_status: All ten tasks remain pending. Closed means the proposed graph has no blocking closure gap; it does not certify implementation, actual host availability, or scenario success.
review_scope.dag_status: Native snapshot blocked_by lists match every task dependency. The catalog frontier and interface producer/consumer graph agree. The machine DAG is intentionally a later compilation product and its present absence is not a finding.
review_scope.failure_review: All 42 unique outcome/mode records were independently examined against the proportionality locks and declared public seams. A read-only table check confirmed every expansion lookup and nonempty reentry/basis evidence. The controller still owns the prescribed validator gate; this report is not a claim that its validator ran.
review_scope.proof_denominator: Source tickets require 6 routing/confirmation scenarios in T15, 7 history/resume scenarios in T16, 8 incremental/fake-completion scenarios in T17, and 8 external-recovery scenarios in T18, each on both actual hosts: at least 58 source-defined host/scenario cells. Implementation-ticket behavior coverage, SG-01, SG-02, and ledger obligations supplement these cells through existing seams; they cannot be replaced by a baseline suite count.
review_scope.isolation: Independent task branches may overlap allowed source paths; the controller serializes integration and reruns affected checks. Evaluators own only their scenario subtree, subjects use unique synthetic fixture workspaces, the root launches actual hosts without bypassing nested-worker guards, and discovered physical targets require explicit mutual exclusion.
review_scope.scope: Canonical helper and adapter changes, generated project-local assets, tests and run-owned evidence are covered. No installer/marketplace/version/deployment/background-watcher or target-product discussion mutation is required. Existing journal authority, legacy readers, free planning, suppress rules and visual architecture remain protected.
